blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
At Czarnikow, every Monday we plan the week ahead. We use going to for plans we have already decided. For example: I am going to call Brazil, we are going to visit a client, she is going to send the report.

Planning is simple, but it helps a lot. When you write your plan on Monday, you know what to do next. You do not forget your meetings, and you feel calm.

Today we learn five useful words and we practise a lot. Take your time. Every sentence counts. Quem planeja, chega.

items.q: When does the team plan the week?
options: At the end of the month
items.why: "every Monday we plan the week ahead".

items.q: What is "going to" used for?
items.why: "We use going to for plans we have already decided."

items.q: How does planning help you, according to the text?
options: You feel calm and do not forget meetings
items.why: "you feel calm" e "You do not forget your meetings".

items.q: The text suggests that the writer thinks planning is…
items.why: Inferência: "it helps a lot", "you feel calm" — o tom é positivo sobre planejar.

items.q: The writer would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: Writing a plan helps you remember your meetings.
It is a waste of time to plan the week.
Monday is a good day to plan.
Planning can make you feel calm.
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo defende o planejamento — dizer que é perda de tempo vai contra a mensagem.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James falando dos planos da semana. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, team. It is Monday, so let's plan the week together. I am going to share my plans first, and then you can share yours. It is a simple habit, but it helps us a lot.

Today I am going to call Brazil at ten o'clock. It is an important call about coffee prices, so please do not book a meeting for me at that time. I am going to need about one hour.

Tomorrow we are going to visit a client together. We are going to leave the office at nine, so please be ready. It is going to be a good day, and I think the client is going to be happy to see us.

On Wednesday, Ana is going to send the big report. Please help her if she asks. On Thursday, I am going to travel to London, and I am going to come back on Friday morning.

So, we are going to be busy, but we are going to finish everything by Friday. Take your time, do good work, and remember: every plan counts. Have a great week, everyone.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is James going to do at ten o'clock today?
items.why: "Today I am going to call Brazil at ten o'clock."

items.q: What are they going to do tomorrow?
options: Stay in the office all day
items.why: "Tomorrow we are going to visit a client together."

items.q: Why does James ask the team not to book a meeting at ten?
options: Because he is going to travel
Because he has an important call
Because he is going to rest
items.why: Inferência: a ligação com o Brasil é importante, por isso ele não quer reunião nesse horário.

items.q: How does James feel about the client visit?
options: He thinks it will be a bad day
He does not want to go
items.why: Inferência: "It is going to be a good day" e "the client is going to be happy" — ele está otimista.

items.q: When are they going to finish everything?
items.why: "we are going to finish everything by Friday."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I write my plan every Monday morning." A plan is…
items.why: Plan = plano: aquilo que você decide fazer.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We are going to visit the client ___ week."
items.why: Next week = próxima semana.

items.q: "The report is not ready today, but it will be ready soon." Soon means…
items.why: Soon = em breve, dentro de pouco tempo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I am going to ___ to London on Thursday."
items.why: Travel = viajar.

items.q: "On Tuesday we are going to visit a client." To visit means to…
items.why: Visit = visitar, ir ver alguém.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que usamos ao planejar a semana no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's plan ahead for next week." To plan ahead means to…
options: make plans before the time comes
items.why: Plan ahead = planejar com antecedência.

items.q: "I am going to set up a meeting for Monday." To set up a meeting means to…
items.why: Set up = organizar, marcar.

items.q: "We are going to go over the plan on Monday." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, passar por algo com cuidado.

items.q: "Ana is going to carry out the plan this week." To carry out means to…
items.why: Carry out = executar, colocar em prática.

items.q: "I am busy now, but I am going to catch up on my emails later." To catch up on emails means to…
options: do the emails you are behind on
items.why: Catch up on = pôr em dia, fazer o que ficou atrasado.
